defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Cover routine tank damage with its 20% reduction and rotate it between Ardent Defender windows; usable while stunned.

defensives.name: Ardent Defender
defensives.usage_rule: Use it freely on its 1.5 minute cooldown for any predictable spike or low-health moment; the 30% reduction also turns the next killing blow into a reset to 20% health.

defensives.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
defensives.usage_rule: Plan this one around named mechanics rather than pressing it on sight, since 50% reduction for 8 seconds only comes back every 3 minutes, or every other pull with Empyrean Authority's second charge.

defensives.name: Blessing of Spellwarding
defensives.usage_rule: Immunity to magic damage for 10 seconds on yourself or an ally; it shares its cooldown with Blessing of Protection and does not clear existing debuffs.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity for lethal hits or for dropping a debuff with a cancelaura macro; enemies ignore you while it is up, so hold aggro with Hand of Reckoning or take Final Stand, and mind the 30 second Forbearance.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency full heal: heal yourself with Word of Glory instead and save this to rescue another player, since it applies Forbearance for 30 seconds.
